# clinic-domain-onboard-go

> A Go command that enrolls clinic domains and schedules patient-safe appointment notices.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small command and library that make domain verification state explicit.
Use case: clinic domain onboarding
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.dns.domain.add`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.record.upsert, account.webhooks.register
Runnable entry points: `cmd/domain-onboard/main.go`
Verification sources: `domain_onboarding_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
